brief: Digital decay, RGB splits, controlled chaos. For experimental, breakcore, glitch and noise artists who break rules on purpose. 100-170 BPM.
renderer: FLUX.2 klein-4B, Apple MPS, fp16, 20 steps
lettering: none — these plates are deliberately text-free
